packageRules.description: Digest pinning belongs to GitHub Actions, where every workflow here already pins by digest with the version in a trailing comment. Applied globally it also reaches the pre-commit manager, which pins hook revisions to commit SHAs; that update fails and shows up as 'Error updating branch: update failure'. The zizmor version of zizmor-action is left out: the action accepts only a plain X.Y.Z, see the shared preset.

The committed reference screenshots are pixel-locked to the Playwright Docker image, and ui/scripts/docker-test.mjs derives that image tag from the installed playwright package. Vitest, its browser provider and playwright therefore belong in one pull request, which needs regenerated references (npm run test:update:docker) before it can be green.
The generic parent carries the Polarion platform baseline. It travels alone and is reviewed by a person.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Refreshes the transitive packages of ui/package-lock.json, or they stay pinned to vulnerable versions.
